_comment: cloud-ci-authz-coverage gate policy (issue #770; AUTH-005 pipeline-as-product backstop). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. The gate detects axum Router control-plane surfaces (mutating route or per-resource path param) and requires fail-closed authz: a router-level auth layer (auth_layer_idents) OR every mutating handler invoking a recognized authz guard (authz_guard_idents). /healthz-style reads are exempt via exempt_path_substrings. Ratchets vs frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (today's known surfaces) so the gate lands green and only NEW unauthenticated control planes block. The remediation doctrine is intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.
frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces: iam/facade/identity-service/src/users/mod.rs::router[delete <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Groups/{{id}}")>; delete <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users/{{id}}")>; get <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Groups")>; get <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Groups/{{id}}")>; get <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users")>; get <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users/{{id}}")>; patch <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Groups/{{id}}")>; patch <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users/{{id}}")>; post <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Groups")>; post <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users")>; put <unresolved:&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/{{tenant}}/Users/{{id}}")>]
_frozen_baseline_note: Pre-existing unauthenticated / unprovable HTTP control-plane surfaces, FROZEN as of issue #770 and re-keyed by stable signature (file + sorted (method, route-path) tuples) after the PR #780 review broadened detection (const-path resolution, on(MethodFilter), comment/string-stripped coverage). Each is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team; the gate freezes them so it lands GREEN and blocks only NEW unauthenticated control planes. SHRINK-ONLY + AUTOMATED: regenerate via the gate binary `--write` (do not hand-edit); a fixed/removed surface drops its key and a stale key self-cleans via AC-STALE-BASELINE. Per-surface classification: (1) identity-service SCIM router — handlers ARE authz-covered (authorize_scim + authorize_token_for), but its routes use non-literal `&format!("{SCIM_BASE}/...")` paths the engine cannot resolve to concrete strings, so it fails closed as AC-UNRESOLVED-ROUTE-PATH; grandfathered (covered-but-unprovable-path); remediation is to make the SCIM paths const/literal so the gate can prove coverage. (2) identity-workload-rest — /authorize, /authorize-with-token, /authorize:batch ARE covered (authorizer.authorize / authorize_with_token); but POST /tokens/validate (token validation, no Cedar authz decision) and POST /principals/{id}:suspend|retire (lifecycle_transition does NO caller-identity check) are genuinely uncovered — ESCALATE: a real pre-existing unauthenticated mutating control plane (workload lifecycle), tracked here so the gate is green, owned by iam for remediation. (3) k8s cluster-lifecycle — header-trust tenant check, not a verified-principal authz decision. (4) k8s control-plane-host + tenant-quota — derive no caller identity. (5) ci-controller /gate-run — no authz. NOTE: oya/ci-webhook-gateway POST /webhook/github is NOT baselined — it is covered by fail-closed signature verification (signature::verify_any, added to authz_guard_idents). Remediation per surface: see the doctrine in intelligence/adapters/rest + tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app.

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known unauthenticated surfaces. The two reference surfaces (intelligence/adapters/rest, tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app) are GREEN by construction (they carry authz). Pre-existing unauthenticated surfaces are frozen in frozen_unauthenticated_surfaces (shrink-only). Only a NEW unauthenticated control plane blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy, gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor surface census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: intelligence/adapters/rest/src/lib.rs (admin_tenant_allowed + PDP gate.decide + constant_time_eq) and tenancy/facade/tenant-lifecycle-app/src/lib.rs (authenticate_caller + authorize() per route).
